mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which leads to a reduction in inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a central bank policy response and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where INDPRO remains below 98.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 232.5 over two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of a future federal funds rate hike and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 232.5 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 99.0 signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 135,000 in two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of a dovish monetary policy shift and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where PAYEMS falls below 135,000 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a decline in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window.
